content.text: {"notes":["The requested joint angles and angular velocities are joint-local channels at absolute time t=1.0 s; angles are unwrapped and use rad, while angular velocities use rad/s.","The tip position is requested in the right-handed world frame (x-forward, y-left, z-up) in meters.","Both joints receive a constant applied torque of -0.16083590438444717 N·m; joint_1 additionally receives +0.5 N·m on the scheduled interval [0.4604, 0.5604) s.","joint_limit_by_T is true if either joint reaches an angle magnitude of 2.8 rad by t=1.0 s; contact onset is rearmed below 2.795 rad."]}
